ticket_shown_to_model.title: Critical Audit Log Gap in Payment Gateway v2 (APAC Production)
ticket_shown_to_model.description: We have detected a significant gap in the audit logs generated by Payment Gateway v2 in our APAC production environment. Several transaction events are missing from the log stream, which is a critical compliance issue. This potentially affects records for over 6000 users. Immediate investigation is required to identify the missing time range and prevent further data loss.

parsed.summary: Audit log gap detected in Payment Gateway v2, potentially affecting 6225 users, with high priority and critical business impact.
